intent: Dashboard: returning to a repository shows its file tree at once, as you left it
notes: Switching between repositories (for example between workspace tabs) used
to reset the Repo view's file tree each time: folders collapsed and the
default document reopened. Each repository now keeps its own expanded
folders and selected file, keyed by its registry key (two repositories
with the same name never share them).
A file-list response that arrives after you have moved to another
repository is now ignored. Before, a late response could change the
repository you had switched to. Each Repo visit also used to add another
